data.name: Night Crew
data.detailed_description:
"Explore Twilight Palms Mall, a pure-blooded American retail paradise! Frequented by happy customers, cannibals, spiritual beings, and our lovely mall staff."

With proximity voice chat, physics based movement and up to 5 other friends, complete your shift as a member of the Night Crew!

Oh god. It Knows.

You are being hunted. Run or hide from nocturnal monstrosities that track with you not only with sight, but sound and smell too. That pie you pinched from the bakery, may mean you end up in the next batch.

The Job

Management have a couple of boxes they want ticking. Luckily, they have several suckers 𝚝𝚊𝚕𝚎𝚗𝚝𝚎𝚍 𝚊𝚜𝚜𝚎𝚝𝚜 to sort them out. Fix cabling, clean up trash, 𐌄𐋄Ꝋ𐌐𐌂𐌉𐌔𐌄 𐌔Ꝋ𐌌𐌄 𐌔𐌓𐌉𐌐𐌉𐌕𐌔... Whatever it takes to keep the suits happy.

And If you or one of your companions meets an unfortunate end... well... someone will have to clean up that mess...

Many ways to die.

Served in soup. Neck snapped. Lost in madness. Crew members are exposed to a myriad of horrifying entities in the faint glow of neon light. Maybe it's time to break out that torch, and a can of bear spray.

Shareholder Satisfaction

Keep management happy and your head above water - or you may lose it.

The executives want one thing: year on year growth. Just keep the freaks under the rug.

𝙽𝚘𝚝𝚑𝚒𝚗𝚐 𝚒𝚜 𝚜𝚙𝚘𝚘𝚔𝚒𝚎𝚛 𝚝𝚑𝚊𝚗 𝚊 𝚍𝚒𝚙 𝚒𝚗 𝚜𝚑𝚊𝚛𝚎 𝚙𝚛𝚒𝚌𝚎𝚜!

The Crew

Pick your unique crew member, each with powerful and upgradable traits that allow you to make a huge impact. Each misfit plays differently, and different combinations will give you endless ways to complete your tasks!

Features

Here's what you can experience already:

  • 👻 10 unique enemies

  • 𝚐𝚛𝚎𝚊𝚝 𝚓𝚘𝚋 𝚜𝚊𝚝𝚒𝚜𝚏𝚊𝚌𝚝𝚒𝚘𝚗

  • 🏃‍➡️ 6 iconic crew members

  • 𝚠𝚘𝚗𝚍𝚎𝚛𝚏𝚞𝚕 𝚌𝚘-𝚠𝚘𝚛𝚔𝚎𝚛𝚜

  • ⬆️ 50+ upgrades

  • 𝚑𝚎𝚊𝚕𝚝𝚑𝚢 𝚠𝚘𝚛𝚔-𝚕𝚒𝚏𝚎 𝚋𝚊𝚕𝚊𝚗𝚌𝚎

  • ⌚ 20+ tasks

  • 𝚒𝚗𝚍𝚞𝚜𝚝𝚛𝚢 𝚜𝚝𝚊𝚗𝚍𝚊𝚛𝚍 𝚌𝚘𝚖𝚙𝚎𝚗𝚜𝚊𝚝𝚒𝚘𝚗

What's not to love?

We’re adding a tonne more content, remember to join our Discord for the latest news!

data.short_description: A lo-fi mall with high-key problems. Foul creatures roam the halls - and management still expects YOU to mop the floor. Even though the floor ate Gary. Welcome to the Night Crew. You are 𝙙𝙚𝙛𝙞𝙣𝙞𝙩𝙚𝙡𝙮 not paid enough for this.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5 6th Gen+
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 25 GB available space

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i5 8th Gen+
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 2060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 25 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: Night Crew is a low-fidelity horror game. It contains cartoonish but frequent displays of blood and gore, as well as psychological elements.
